2.152.10
ChartLegend.DockToChartArea
Applies to RDL 2008/01, RDL 2010/01, and RDL 2016/01
The ChartLegend.DockToChartArea element specifies the name of the ChartArea on which to draw
a ChartLegend. The ChartLegend.DockToChartArea element is optional. If the
ChartLegend.DockToChartArea element is present, its value MUST be a String ([XMLSCHEMA2/2]
section 3.2.1). If this element is not specified or if it does not match any ChartArea name, the legend
MUST be drawn relative to the chart area.
Following is the parent element of the ChartLegend.DockToChartArea element.
Parent elements
ChartLegend
The following is the XML Schema definition of the ChartLegend.DockToChartArea element.
 <xsd:element name="DockToChartArea" type="xsd:string" minOccurs="0" />
